Prednisone and Budesonide are corticosteroids, while Azathioprine and Mycophenolate mofetil are immunosuppressants. Lamivudine, however, is an antiviral medication primarily used for hepatitis B and is not indicated for autoimmune hepatitis treatment. Therefore, Lamivudine is the drug that is NOT used in the treatment of autoimmune hepatitis.
